title: When Repair Accuracy Misleads: Training a VLM on Its Own Failures
abstract: arXiv:2611.32982v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-tuning a vision-language model on its own failures is a direct way to repair it, but accuracy on held-out failures, the obvious measure of success, misleads. Many mined failures are not model errors: a human audit of 100 failures of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on questions generated from COCO and GQA found label errors in 37. And mined failures share wording regularities: question-only classifiers get both answers right on 73.2% of held-out failure pairs. We study both traps with verified failure-driven repair (VFR): typed minimal-pair failure mining, verification by three LLM judges that answer without seeing the stored labels, answer-first corrective targets, and LoRA fine-tuning with replay. VFR repairs 82.8% of held-out failures (base model: 10.0%), and on independently labeled, unconditioned pairs it raises overall accuracy from 87.4% to 92.4% through spatial relations, whose accuracy rises from 66.7% to 96.8% even where the wording

translated_title: 当修复准确率产生误导：让视觉语言模型从自身失败中学习
translated_abstract: 在视觉语言模型自身的失败样例上进行微调是修复模型的一种直接方法，但在留出失败样例上的准确率——这一显而易见的成功衡量标准——却会产生误导。许多挖掘出的失败样例并非模型错误：对Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct在基于COCO和GQA生成的问题上的100个失败样例进行人工审计，发现其中37个存在标签错误。此外，挖掘出的失败样例存在措辞上的规律性：仅基于问题的分类器在73.2%的留出失败样本对上都能答对两个答案。我们通过“验证式失败驱动修复”方法研究了这两个陷阱，该方法包括：类型化的最小对失败样例挖掘、由三个大语言模型评审在不查看存储标签的情况下回答问题进行验证、以答案为先的纠正目标，以及结合回放的LoRA微调。VFR修复了82.8%的留出失败样例（基础模型仅为10.0%），并且在独立标注、无条件限制的样本对上，通过空间关系将整体准确率从87.4%提升至92.4%，其中空间关系的准确率从66.7%大幅提升至96.8%。
tldr: 该论文提出“验证式失败驱动修复”（VFR）方法，揭示了用模型自身失败样例微调视觉语言模型时准确率评估的两大陷阱（标签错误与措辞规律性），并通过LLM评审验证和最小对样例挖掘，将Qwen3-VL的空间关系准确率从66.7%提升至96.8%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Verified Failure-driven Repair (VFR), which exposes two pitfalls in repair accuracy evaluation when fine-tuning a VLM on its own failures—label errors and wording regularities—and leverages LLM-judge verification and typed minimal-pair mining to boost spatial-relation accuracy from 66.7% to 96.8%.
